reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday in shared/schedules.ts and routes every existing holiday check (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) through it.

duplication.why: The holiday membership rule is defined once; the surrounding 'weekend or holiday' predicate is still written out at four sites, as it was before the change.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which the server schedule app already imports from.

scope.why: Only the holiday checks and focused tests are changed.

maintainability.why: Small, clear helper with a default for missing lists; a combined skip-day predicate would have removed the remaining repeated weekend-or-holiday expression.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No holiday check remains that calls includes() on the list directly.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the new rule exists only in isHoliday.
